epsilon_rule: smallest epsilon in {0.1,0.2,0.3} such that (a) all 3 public calibration donors remain reachable at >=L2 with the full map/synth/validate chain inside the routed share 1000*(1-epsilon), and (b) the exploration share funds >=3 complete guided far-region forays (L0+L1+L2 each, ~14 units) including at least one map+synth synthesis (~45 units)

All 3 public donors are literal seed examples of motifs M02/M05/M06, so routing alone reaches them and epsilon is NOT calibrated on public-pair recall failure (recorded openly); it is calibrated on the maintainability margin + T63 necessity. epsilon=0.1 satisfies rule clauses (a) and (b) and is the smallest admissible value.
